soundness_flags.label: ass:known-uniform-design and ass:design-known
soundness_flags.one_line: LiuEtAl2017EmpiricalHOIF does not support the claimed standard “known covariate design”: its empirical-HOIF construction is motivated by avoiding estimation of a general unknown covariate density, whereas the proposal assumes that density is exactly known and uniform.
